metadata.scenario: A new customer complains that the installation process was not completed as promised. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mary O'Connor. I'm calling because I'm really frustrated with the service I received. I’m sorry to hear that, Mary. Can you please tell me more about the issue? Well, I was told that the installation of my IV therapy equipment would be completed yesterday, but it wasn’t. I’m really anxious about not having it ready. I understand how concerning that must be, especially given your ongoing therapy. Let me check what happened. Can you hold on just a moment while I look into this? Sure, I’ll wait. Thank you, Mary. It looks like there was a miscommunication with our supply team regarding the equipment delivery. I sincerely apologize for the oversight. That’s really disappointing. I rely on this therapy, and I thought everything was arranged properly. I completely understand your frustration. To resolve this, I’ll personally ensure that a technician visits your home today to complete the setup. That would be great, but I really need assurance that it will actually happen this time. Absolutely, I’ll stay in touch with you throughout the process and provide you with the technician’s direct contact information. Would that help ease your anxiety? Yes, that would definitely make me feel better. Thank you for that. You’re welcome, Mary. Also, I noticed during your last visit that you might benefit from some additional support with your anxiety during the therapy. Yes, I think that would help a lot. Can you tell me more about it? We offer a service for companion care that can provide emotional support and distraction during your therapy sessions. It’s $25 to $30 per hour. Would you be interested in that? I might be interested, but I’d like to think it over after today’s appointment. Of course, take your time. I will make a note to follow up with you after the technician has visited. Thank you, I appreciate that. You’re welcome. I will call you later to confirm the technician's arrival time. Is there anything else I can assist you with right now? No, that covers my concerns for now. Great! Thank you for your understanding, Mary. We’ll get this resolved today. Thank you, Margaret. I’ll talk to you later. Talk to you soon, Mary. Have a good day!
